projects.description: The name of the projects to initialize.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files after initialization.

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

prefix.description: The prefix to use for the generated Angular components.

withSharedLibraries.description: Whether to initialize the workspace with shared libraries (components, forms, etc.).
